title: Tincraft 2 official translations
description: The official Resource pack for translations
body:
# Tincraft 2 Official Translations
Tincraft 2 Official Translations Resource pack adds official translations to Tincraft 2. If you want to see a language added you can open a issue on the official tincraft 2 repo or open a Pull request to add translations your self.

## installing
Download the .ZIP file and drop it in the resourcepacks folder in your minecraft


## Current languages included
* Finnish
